# Hengam

> Hengam is shift-scheduling software for cafes, restaurants, retail teams, and
> anyone who builds a weekly rota. Managers write coverage rules in plain
> English; Hengam parses them, generates a schedule with a deterministic
> constraint solver, checks it against availability, time off, and target hours,
> and explains in business terms when a week cannot be staffed.

Hengam is a web application. It is free to start, with a Pro plan for teams that
need unlimited schedules, AI rule parsing, and exports. The interface is
available in English and Persian (فارسی).

## How it works

- Describe coverage in plain English ("1 supervisor and 1 barista from open until 4pm").
- Add your team, their roles, availability windows, time off, and target weekly hours.
- Hengam generates the week deterministically, then checks every shift against every rule.
- When a week is impossible, Hengam names the exact constraint that broke instead of quietly producing a bad schedule.
- Export the finished week as CSV, PNG, or PDF, or share per-employee schedule views.
